rationale: Both relations describe the state of a location being open (door_open and gate_open). The argument slots for location are in the same position (0) in both relations. The usage of these relations in the context of actions (enter_tree_and_descend_stairs, turn_key_on_beech, cat_open_castle_gates) also support this equivalence. The text excerpts for both relations are '(door_open ?d - location)' and '(gate_open ?castle - location)', respectively, which further reinforce the equivalence. The only difference is the predicate name, but this is not a significant difference in the context of the relations. Therefore, the relations are equivalent and have the same order of arguments.
